title: NekoSune Community Modpack
description: Community Modpack powered by NekoSune Community
body:
By NekoSuneVR – Built by the Community, for the Community!

Welcome to the NekoSune Community modpack — a community-driven project brought to life with love, creativity, and the goal of making modded Minecraft fun again! This is the first personal modpack from NekoSuneVR in years, inspired by the classic modpack days of 2016 — but now rebuilt with modern tech, fresh ideas, and your input!

This pack is not just mine – it’s yours too. Every mod added comes from community requests. Whether it’s your favorite tech mod, dungeon crawler, or a storage system you can’t live without, you help shape what’s in this pack.

Features

 All About Tech: Dive deep into a world of advanced machinery, power systems, automation, and industry. Featuring mods like Mekanism, Big Reactors, Applied Energistics, and many more!

Smarter Storage: Say goodbye to chest clutter with high-tech digital storage systems.

Adventure Awaits: Battle through dungeons and face powerful bosses in The Twilight Forest and beyond.

Lightweight But Packed: A carefully balanced pack designed to run well on most systems while still delivering big tech power and tons of content.

A True Throwback: Inspired by the spirit of the modpacks from NekoSuneVr back in 2016 — now modernized with community ideas and feedback!

A Community Project



This is a community modpack, plain and simple. Mods are added by request, and the entire project is about bringing players together to build, explore, and have fun with tech and creativity at the center. We're working to launch a public server soon, where everyone can play, build mega bases, and enjoy the experience together.



Support Means Growth



Any support — whether you play the pack, request a mod, or share it with friends — helps us keep growing. Your feedback and involvement go directly into improving and expanding the pack. This is just the beginning of something special.



The NekoSune Community Pack Promise



If you love tech mods, big builds, storage systems, and shared adventures, this is the pack for you. It’s big, powerful, and made with care – yet easy to run and play. Let’s bring back the good times in modded Minecraft.

Come join the fun, help shape the future of the modpack, and become part of the NekoSune Community today.
